spec.definitions: def sumFromOne (n : Nat) : Nat := ∑ k in Finset.Icc 1 n, k
spec.conclusion: ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → sumFromOne n = n * (n + 1) / 2
spec.proof:
by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h : n = 0
      · subst h
        decide
      · have hn' : 1 ≤ n := by omega
        rw [sumFromOne, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top hn']
        rw [ih hn']
        omega
